source_refs.note: 'Improving Models Using Hyperparameter Tuning' under topic 6.8, as printed (PDF 87, printed 83).

blocks.text: Hyperparameter tuning adjusts model settings. These settings control learning behavior. It helps improve accuracy. It reduces errors in predictions. Parameters are tested with different values. Validation data guides tuning. Proper tuning improves performance. Poor tuning reduces effectiveness.
